blocks.en:
For $1\leq p<\infty$ we have\[
\|u\|_{1,p}=\left\{\int_{\Omega}\left(|u|^p+\sum_{i=1}^m\left|\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x_i}\right|^p\right)\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/p},
\]
\[
\|u\|_{2,p}=\left\{\int_{\Omega}\left(|u|^p+\sum_{i=1}^m\left|\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x_i}\right|^p+\sum_{i,j=1}^m\left|\dfrac{\partial^2u}{\partial x_i\partial x_j}\right|^p\right)\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/p}.
\]
blocks.zh:
对 $1\leq p<\infty$, 有\[
\|u\|_{1,p}=\left\{\int_{\Omega}\left(|u|^p+\sum_{i=1}^m\left|\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x_i}\right|^p\right)\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/p},
\]
\[
\|u\|_{2,p}=\left\{\int_{\Omega}\left(|u|^p+\sum_{i=1}^m\left|\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x_i}\right|^p+\sum_{i,j=1}^m\left|\dfrac{\partial^2u}{\partial x_i\partial x_j}\right|^p\right)\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/p}.
\]
blocks.label: ex:sobolev-first-second-norms

blocks.en: The Heaviside function $H(x)$ is in $L^p(-1,1)$ for any $p\in[1,\infty]$. However, it is not in $W^{1,p}(-1,1)$ since its distributional derivative, the Dirac delta, cannot be represented by an $L^p(-1,1)$ function. Similarly, the absolute value function $f(x)=|x|$ is in $W^{1,p}(-1,1)$, since its distributional derivative can be represented by the $L^p(-1,1)$ function\[f'(x)=\begin{cases}-1&x<0\\1&x>0\end{cases}\]However, $f$ is not in $W^{2,p}(-1,1)$ since its second distributional derivative $(2\delta)$ cannot be represented by a function in $L^p$.
blocks.zh: Heaviside 函数 $H(x)$ 对任意 $p\in[1,\infty]$ 都属于 $L^p(-1,1)$. 然而, 它不属于 $W^{1,p}(-1,1)$, 因为其分布导数, 即 Dirac delta, 不能由 $L^p(-1,1)$ 函数表示. 类似地, 绝对值函数 $f(x)=|x|$ 属于 $W^{1,p}(-1,1)$, 因为其分布导数可以由以下 $L^p(-1,1)$ 函数表示:\[f'(x)=\begin{cases}-1&x<0\\1&x>0\end{cases}\]然而, $f$ 不属于 $W^{2,p}(-1,1)$, 因为其二阶分布导数 $(2\delta)$ 不能由 $L^p$ 中的函数表示.
blocks.label: ex:heaviside-absolute-value-sobolev-membership

blocks.en:
Consider the function\[f(\bm{x}):=|\bm{x}|^{\alpha}=\left(\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^2\right)^{\alpha/2}\]on $B=B_1(\bm{0})\subset\mathbb{R}^m$, the ball of radius one in $\mathbb{R}^m$. One can easily check using spherical coordinates that if $\alpha+m>0$ this function is integrable. Thus, if $p\alpha>-m$ we have $f\in L^p(B)$.

Formally taking partial derivatives we get\[\dfrac{\partial f}{\partial x_i}(\bm{x})=\alpha x_i\left(\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^2\right)^{\alpha/2-1}=\alpha|\bm{x}|^{(\alpha-2)/2}x_i\]\[
\dfrac{\partial^2f}{\partial x_i\partial x_j}(\bm{x})=\alpha(\alpha-2)x_ix_j\left(\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^2\right)^{\alpha/2-2}+\alpha\left(\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^2\right)^{\alpha/2-1}\delta_{ij}
\]where $\delta_{ij}$ is the Kronecker delta.

We can use standard techniques of improper integrals to show that if the formal derivative has an integrable singularity, then that function is a representative of the distributional derivative. Using this and calculating the norms we get (after some work)\begin{itemize}
\item $f\in W^{1,p}(B)$ if and only if $p(\alpha-1)>-m$ (i.e., $\alpha>1-m/p$).
\item $f\in W^{2,p}(B)$ if and only if $p(\alpha-2)>-m$ (i.e., $\alpha>2-m/p$).
\end{itemize}Similar calculations show that $|\bm{x}|^{\alpha}\in W^{k,p}(B)$ if and only if $\alpha>k-m/p$.
blocks.zh:
考察函数\[f(\bm{x}):=|\bm{x}|^{\alpha}=\left(\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^2\right)^{\alpha/2}\]定义在 $B=B_1(\bm{0})\subset\mathbb{R}^m$ 上, 这是 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 中半径为一的球. 利用球坐标很容易检验, 若 $\alpha+m>0$, 则此函数可积. 因而若 $p\alpha>-m$, 则有 $f\in L^p(B)$.

形式地取偏导数得到\[\dfrac{\partial f}{\partial x_i}(\bm{x})=\alpha x_i\left(\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^2\right)^{\alpha/2-1}=\alpha|\bm{x}|^{(\alpha-2)/2}x_i\]\[
\dfrac{\partial^2f}{\partial x_i\partial x_j}(\bm{x})=\alpha(\alpha-2)x_ix_j\left(\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^2\right)^{\alpha/2-2}+\alpha\left(\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^2\right)^{\alpha/2-1}\delta_{ij}
\]其中 $\delta_{ij}$ 为 Kronecker delta.

可用反常积分的标准方法证明, 若形式导数具有可积奇点, 则该函数为分布导数的一个代表元. 利用这一点并计算范数, 经过一些工作得到\begin{itemize}
\item $f\in W^{1,p}(B)$ 当且仅当 $p(\alpha-1)>-m$ (即 $\alpha>1-m/p$).
\item $f\in W^{2,p}(B)$ 当且仅当 $p(\alpha-2)>-m$ (即 $\alpha>2-m/p$).
\end{itemize}类似的计算表明, $|\bm{x}|^{\alpha}\in W^{k,p}(B)$ 当且仅当 $\alpha>k-m/p$.
blocks.label: ex:radial-power-sobolev-membership
